outcomes.reason: All five criteria met: rejects no-reuse cache; uses 4/150 ms and 15/800 capacity headroom; identifies writes/memory; reconsideration combines repeated demand with meaningful latency/load and measurement; strict freshness routes to source or proven design, without claiming TTL/invalidation guarantees. Each credited inference follows cited prefix content plus supplied workload facts.

sourceChecks.claim: Initial cache population still requires source work and storage.
Cache hits need not be fresh.
Writes and invalidations are separate and consistency is not guaranteed.
TTL-bearing entries can be evicted for capacity.
Shared external cache reduces private copies but carries operating costs.
Miss spikes and outages need coalescing or bounded downstream work.
Cache value depends on repeated use, source cost, change frequency and performance testing; rarely reused or frequently changing data may not justify caching.
